title: Pacta RPC-pinned control-plane records
description: Read-only control-plane observations of 20 protocols (12 Ethereum, 8 Base), each pinned to a canonical block number and block hash and reproducible with cast. These records are NOT EAS-attested: they have no sprint number, no summary document and no Base EAS UID. The Base-EAS-attested Sprint records are in /api/v1/index.json.

attestation.note: No on-chain attestation exists for these records yet; any future attestation will be added here with its UID.

verification: Captured by one Pacta seat over public JSON-RPC and independently re-read at the same pinned blocks by a second seat (block hash, runtime bytecode size and keccak256, EIP-1967 implementation / admin slots, controller getter, Safe getThreshold / getOwners, timelock delay). Two records were corrected by the re-read (Moonwell admin contract, Uniswap V3 factory owner contract).

entries.onchain_observed: AcrossHubPool (0xc186fA914353c44b2E33eBE05f21846F1048bEda) verified on Ethereum Mainnet at canonical block #26,414,499 (19,572 bytes runtime code).
